item.title: NO CANDY OF POP WITH KS SNAP DOLLARS
item.description: Kansas is joining other states in putting restrictions on candy and soda with its Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, known as SNAP. Governor Laura Kelly announced yesterday, March 4th, that Kansas is joining 21 other states in implementing the restriction on candy and soda with SNAP dollars. She says she has always supported policies that incentivize healthy eating. item.title: OZ PARENTS UPSET
item.description: Following back-to-back weapon threats at Trojan Elementary School in Osawatomie, parents are asking for greater transparency from the school district. item.description: The Anderson County Detention Center used to be the premier facility in the area–when it was built in 2007.
